description: FOUND s514 (Fable, 2026-10-10 12:41) by the s513g merge-review probe ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s513/review/p513g/tags.pl (perl -> base cc3caca6 -> s513g tree 499ffad6: base = tree, both die).  perl: `%EXPORT_TAGS = ( ALL => [ ,  ] )` (File/Spec/Functions.pm:36); the tag is a union of two LITERAL qw lists in the same file -- a static fact.  s513g's `_expand_import_tags` (Pl/Parser.pm) reads `import_sets`, which the walk fills only from literal `qw()` tags, so `:ALL` expands to nothing ("a tag the facts do not hold imports nothing").  FIX SHAPE (rule 11, the general mechanism): when the walk reads `%EXPORT_TAGS = (TAG => [ ... ])` whose elements are `` / `` (or `\`), expand them from the module's own already-read lists -- the idiom appears in File::Spec::Functions, Capture::Tiny (`all => \`, overlaid by s513g), Scalar::Util-style modules and many CPAN dists; a facts overlay for File::Spec::Functions is the per-module alternative but the idiom is general.  Guard: a fixture module with `ALL => [, ]` + `use Fx ':ALL'` calling an  name; perl-oracle row.  Not a drop (the call is emitted as a call to an undefined sub -> a run-time die), so the census does not see it; the detector (#2610) does not either (the sub IS installed by Exporter at run time -- the failure is the import, not the parse).
subject: SILENT WRONG (import): a COMPUTED export tag built from the module's own literal lists -- `our %EXPORT_TAGS = ( ALL => [ ,  ] )` (File::Spec::Functions, a common idiom) -- is invisible to the static export scan, so `use File::Spec::Functions ':ALL'; canonpath(...)` dies "Undefined subroutine &main::canonpath" where perl imports everything; base = s513g tree
